 Order

1. Vide the present application, the applicants/ petitioners seek modification of the order dated 25.09.2023 to the extent that the name of the School mentioned in para 8 of the said order namely Govt. Cooed Senior Secondary School, Block O, Lajpat Nagar-III, New Delhi-110024, be modified to Shaheed Hemu Kalani Govt. Sarvodaya Bal Vidyalaya, Ring Road Lapjpat Nagar, New Delhi-110024, as the name of the school has been subsequently changed.
2. In view of the submissions made and for the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed and the order dated 25.09.2023 is modified to the above extent.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/10/2023 at 18:08:12 3.

Accordingly, paragraph no.8 of the order dated 25.09.2023 is substituted and henceforth be read as under:-
8.

Accordingly, the petition is allowed and FIR No.26/2019 dated 17.07.2019 registered under Sections 498A/406/34/354A/377 IPC at P.S. Crime (Women) Cell,
Nanak Pura, Delhi, and all proceeding emanating therefrom are quashed, subject to the petitioners donating one brand new PC alongwith printer costing around Rs.25,000/- along with any other old computer(s) in workable condition to the Govt.
School namely Shaheed Hemu Kalani Govt.
